Use refs, reactive objects, computed values, and watchers according to ownership and side-effect semantics.
The result must make its consequential assumptions, ownership, and decision sequence explicit and reproducible.
Exercise component state transitions, watcher cleanup, routing, hydration when applicable, keyboard semantics, async loading/error states, and representative production build behavior.

The result must not take the tempting shortcut prohibited by this skill: Do not use deep watchers as a substitute for state design, destructure reactive state in ways that lose tracking, or hide cross-component mutation in global singletons.

Every material completion claim must map to observable evidence (vue-engineering decision and boundary evidence; Representative verification results or explicit unavailable checks; Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale; Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification), with simulated, unavailable, inferred, stale, or unresolved evidence labeled rather than converted into certainty.
